name: Davis Friday Fall 2026
information: ## This competition is on a weekday! (Friday) - All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. - Due to limited seating, we likely won't be able to provide designated seating for guests. Guests are welcome find a seat in the the building's common area. This competition is organized in partnership with West Coast Cubing and Davis Cube Club
